differential.name: Non‑ST elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)
differential.rationale: Active diagnosis of acute NSTEMI in a patient with prior MI, CABG, dyslipidemia, obesity and typical risk factors.

differential.name: Unstable angina (acute coronary syndrome)
differential.rationale: Chest ischemia without definitive troponin rise; common in patients with known coronary disease and can mimic NSTEMI.

differential.name: Anemia‑related myocardial ischemia
differential.rationale: Chronic anemia lowers oxygen delivery, precipitating ischemic symptoms in a heart with prior infarction.

differential.name: Panic attack / severe anxiety presenting with chest discomfort
differential.rationale: Documented severe anxiety and panic; can cause chest pain and mimic cardiac events.

differential.name: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (ischemic cardiomyopathy)
differential.rationale: History of MI and CABG plus obesity predispose to HFpEF, which can present with dyspnea and chest discomfort.
